verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents a searchable command palette for discovering and running kitty actions. Mappable actions (kitty-docs-22), remote control and hints are adjacent features: they cover keybindings, scripting and text selection, not palette-style discovery. A command palette is a fair axis for a terminal emulator, so the lack of evidence yields none rather than na.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can discover and run terminal actions from a searchable command palette
